acceptance.text: Lane-scoped drain: today the three run-level park gates in driveLoop (internal/runtime/scheduler.go:5540-5565 degradation, :5570-5601 economy, :5604-5625 identical-failure) return before baton.ReadState at :5626 - the loop parks the whole run before it has even computed which lanes hold admissible work, which is the exact mechanism behind sworn#239's CI evidence. After this slice a work-scoped park crossing (economy, identical-failure, exhaustion causes) pins the affected work - no further tries for it - while the ready computation (:5639-5648) and the lane fan-out (:5650-5676, which already swallows per-lane EFFECT_PARKED at :5666-5673) keep driving every other lane, and the run's state reads parked only when no admissible non-parked work remains. The applicability question is answered the way exhaustedWorkApplies already answers it (status.go:717-832 derives currently-applicable work identities from live Baton state and intersects) - that precedent generalizes rather than being reinvented. The Status reducer's single parked boolean (status.go:228-229, :337-339, :421-423) reflects the same rule on every surface.

Park facts are stamped on the affected work at crossing time: the guards already compute the work identity and then drop it - identicalFailureFacts carries work (economy_guards.go:214-220) and economyGuardCrossing carries work, epoch, try, and effect id (:77-83), but ParkStatus (service.go:144-154) has no work, slice, or paths field and the needs-you row recovers a work id only by rescanning effects for a failed t3 (catalog.go:149-154). After this slice the parked-work facts - work identity, cause, code, and named paths where the refusal carries them (the R4-S9-delivered shapes: productionRefusalBinding{Code, Detail, Paths} at production_dispatch.go:184-189, scopeExhaustionDetail at status.go:856-879) - reach ParkStatus and the board's parked-work row additively (the sworn.run-status/v4 comment at service.go:141-143 blesses additive growth), beside the still-running lanes. Pinned by status and catalog tests asserting the stamped fields.

Lineage-keyed freshness: the identical-failure streak is keyed on the dispatch work id alone (identicalFailureParkCrossing buckets byWork at economy_guards.go:239-263), and work identity folds stage, next role, attempt, and current receipt into the before fingerprint (sliceFingerprintAtAuthority scheduler.go:1900-1916 via driverWorkIdentity :1305-1308) - so any later success in the same slice-stage lineage mints a different work id the streak scan never consults, and a stale failing suffix parks a run that has already recovered (the contract-identity r1 production instance: S1 recovered to verified PASS under fresh work identity, the run then parked on t1/t2's dead facts). After this slice park-guard facts derive from current truth: a consecutive-failure streak breaks on any later success in the same slice-stage lineage, not just the same work id - the lineage key is coarser than the work id and stable across before changes. Pinned by net-new tests over two works in one lineage (every identical-failure test today uses the single testWork fixture, economy_guards_test.go:108-113): a failure streak followed by a lineage success must not park, and a genuine unbroken streak still must.

The conformance surface tells the new truth: the parked-lane e2e scenario (test/e2e/topology_recovery_linux_test.go:818-860) encodes sworn#239 as an accepted workaround - asserting run-state parked on the first drive (:830-833), then re-driving up to five times (:834-847, with the parking-isolation comment) until the independent track's pass lands. After this slice a single drive completes the independent track's admissible work before the run reports parked, the workaround loop is deleted, and the scenario asserts the parked-work row (cause, code, named paths) beside the completed independent work - the scope_failure scenario's assertions (:1080-1085: Park.Cause, FailureCode CANDIDATE_SCOPE_FAILED, FailureDetail naming SLICE_OUTSIDE_SCOPE) are the shape to extend. The retry verb still recovers the parked work exactly as today (:851-859).

constraints: Park is evidence about one work item, never a run verdict, and the pinned work is genuinely pinned: no further tries dispatch for parked work until the operator retry verb clears it - lane-scoping widens what keeps running, never what retries.

Projection and admission semantics only: no journal write schema changes beyond additive typed-event fields, and the cause-scoped park-event replay key (economy_guards.go:362-365, appendParkEventOnce :371-386) is extended for work scope, never replaced - re-drives of an existing journal stay idempotent.

Every run-level parked assertion elsewhere in the suite (surface_parity, turn_recovery, kernel_cumulative, production_journey and the rest) must end green with its scenario's semantics intact - where a scenario's park is genuinely the only remaining work, nothing about its observable behavior changes.
The degradation-budget park stays run-scoped by design in this slice; do not partially rescope it in passing.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
